fidelity_findings: F1 (FIXED): seed used .strict() on request schemas — the frozen core has NO Jackson FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES override (grep of src/main/resources + configs: no hits; Spring Boot default = ignore unknown), so the core ACCEPTS unknown keys. .strict() narrowed the accept set = port bug per index.ts rule 3. Removed; unknown keys now stripped like Jackson.

F2 (FIXED): seed missed jakarta @NotBlank semantics — ' ' passes z.string().min(2)/min(1) but @NotBlank rejects blank. Added notBlank refine (padding still VALID — ' Ann ' accepted). Load-bearing on displayName, login password, currentPassword.

F3 (FIXED): seed used zod's built-in .email() — zod requires a TLD-ish domain, Hibernate's @Email does NOT ('a@b' is VALID per AbstractEmailValidator; also: split at LAST '@', dot-atom local <=64, label <=63, domain <=255). Ported as isJakartaEmail(). Divergence direction of the bug: Java accepts a@b, seed schema rejected it — golden-replay poison.

F4 (FIXED): userView.roles was z.array(z.string()) — observed value domain is exactly Role names (Set<Role> + Enum::name). Narrowed to roleSchema; also applied isJakartaEmail to userView.email so v2 response self-validation matches core-produced values.

F5 (RECORDED, not encoded): DTO takes role:String unconstrained — 'role':'ADMIN' must pass the schema and be refused by the SERVICE (AuthService.java:102); TEACHER join-code gate + constant-time compare are service logic for T-MIG-010. Header comment in auth.ts documents this boundary for the api lane.
known_residuals_for_golden_capture: Bracketed IP-literal domains (a@[127.0.0.1]) and RFC-5322 quoted local parts ('"a b"@x.co'): accepted by Hibernate's validator paths, rejected by isJakartaEmail. Flagged for R6: if a golden capture exercises these, the case needs a justified divergence note (or an isJakartaEmail extension) — NOT a silent schema widening.
